results.notes:
Built end to end behind MODEL_GATEWAY_SEND_RECEIPTS (default off, strict parser, env read per call; off = the old enqueue-then-persist handler, same bodies via a shared queue_refusal mapping).

Proto (additive, tags 18 / 2 / 3), migration 0052 + revert, session-core dedupe: append_message_in_tx looks the id up under the thread lock after every authority check and before the INSERT; same role + trimmed content = first row's sequence and message_id with deduplicated=true (no event, no memory extraction); other content or role = ALREADY_EXISTS; malformed id = INVALID_ARGUMENT; the id is written by a separate UPDATE only when present, so a send without one runs the old INSERT. ZDR: authorize_operation already refuses a ZDR credential before any append; pinned by a trait-level test.

Gateway: queue_input_with_receipts does persist-then-enqueue (closes D3): bounds check, thread from the stream registration (local, or a bus probe), claimed-thread check, store under the id, then queue_input with the id as op_id (owner repeat-check). Answers carry client_message_id / persisted / message_id / deduplicated. Run ended before the store = 404 resend_as_new_turn persisted:false; between store and queue = 404 resend_as_new_turn persisted:true; unrecordable = 409 / 503 retryable / 403 and nothing delivered. QueuedInputRegistry now keeps (text, id) and offers drain_receipted. Unary /v1/invoke names its prompt via send_receipt_id; the stream path needs the sse.rs call-in below.

Frontend: every ordinary send mints msg-<uuid> sent as idempotency_key (not for zdr, regenerate, edit-resubmit, no-user-append); mid-run messages carry client_message_id; delivery matched by id then text; run_ended and end-of-run leftovers (accepted, not delivered, on the live stream's done) are resent under the same id and shown as 'resent' (new tray state, i18n.tr label); strip entries survive the resending turn. Action contract gets clientMessageId, BFF dispatcher maps it, BFF tests pin that receipt fields survive the ended-race rewrite.
